Theorem
[Poincaré--Sobolev inequality]

Source: petersen:page-0302, petersen:page-0305, petersen:page-0306, petersen:page-0307 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-weak-poincare-sobolev-estimate 1. ch7:7.1.13Assume $(M,g)$ has $\Ric \ge (n-1)k$, $k\le 0$. For all smooth $u:M o [0,\infty )$ and $ u \in [1, frac {n}{n-1}]$, \[ \| u-u_{B(x,R)}\| _{ u ,B(x,R)}\le C(n,kD^2)\, R\, \| du\| _{1,B(x,R)}, \] where $R\le D$.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch7-poincare-sobolev ↗ thm:pet-ch7-weak-poincare-sobolev-estimate \sketch Reduce to a nonnegative function vanishing on at least half of $M$ by subtracting a median and splitting into positive and negative parts. Apply subsection 1.5 to dyadic truncations, sum over disjoint level bands, and use $\ell ^{n/(n-1)}$-summability of their gradient masses. This gives the $n/(n-1)$ estimate; Hölder gives the smaller exponents.

□
